name: Monochrome Essay
tagline: Calm, centred essay reels in black and white: a voice-over page, you full frame with small gold serif captions, and white line-art scenes carried by one dot that stands for 'you'. Few cuts, no effects.

captions: White line art on black, one dot for 'you'
The dot moves through a phone of stacked cards
Scenes flicker on and off like an old screen
